about.en: **MUSE Lab** (Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability) is a research group at the [College of Artificial Intelligence](https://ai.szu.edu.cn/), Shenzhen University, led by [Yifan Yuan](./). Our goal is to make generative AI **controllable, interpretable and trustworthy**.
about.zh: **MUSE Lab**（Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability）隶属于[深圳大学人工智能学院](https://ai.szu.edu.cn/)，由[袁一帆](./)助理教授负责。我们的目标是让生成式 AI 更加**可控、可解释、可信**。

about.en: We study why text-to-image diffusion models succeed or fail on specific concepts, and how to edit images and videos precisely and consistently; how large language models and agents stay reliable over long-horizon interaction, free of hallucination, bias and state collapse; and how generative agents can perceive and express human emotion.
about.zh: 我们研究文生图扩散模型为何会在特定概念上成功或失败，以及如何实现精确、一致的图像与视频编辑；研究大语言模型与智能体如何在长程交互中保持可靠，避免幻觉、偏见与状态崩塌；研究生成式智能体如何感知并表达人类情感。

text.en: Images, video and language, modelled together.
text.zh: 联合建模图像、视频与语言。

text.en: Knowing what a model sees, and why it fails.
text.zh: 看懂模型理解了什么、为什么会出错。

text.en: Generating and editing content with precise control.
text.zh: 精确、可控地生成与编辑内容。

text.en: Opening the black box, so that people can trust it.
text.zh: 打开黑箱，让人能够信任。

bio.en: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Fudan University (2025), advised by Prof. Junping Zhang; B.S. in Physics, Fudan University (2019). AIGC research intern on text-to-image generation at Tencent Hunyuan and SenseTime during the Ph.D. Member of the Technical Committee on Hybrid Intelligence and the Science Popularization Committee, Chinese Association of Automation (CAA).
bio.zh: 2025 年博士毕业于复旦大学计算机科学技术专业，师从张军平教授；2019 年本科毕业于复旦大学物理学专业。读博期间曾在腾讯混元文生图组、商汤科技从事 AIGC 算法研究实习。现为中国自动化学会混合智能专委会、普及工作专委会会员。
